description: This file defines a controller class for handling the account extension module in the OpenCart admin interface. It manages rendering the account module configuration page and saving the settings via AJAX.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for the account module in the OpenCart admin extension, extending the base Controller class and providing methods to display and save module configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the account module configuration page, setting up breadcrumb navigation, page title, and loading necessary view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving the account module settings via AJAX, checking permissions, updating settings, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
